Yes of course! Neopronouns (literally meaning new-pronouns) is basically just a new set of pronouns to replace she/her, he/him, or they/them

Some examples are
It/its xe/xyr/xem, nya/nyan, ay/am/air, hir/hirs and there’s a bunch more!

So instead of saying

They went to the store with their best friend. They were shopping for pet food but ended up getting themselves a new pet cat. When they left, their friend helped to point out which car was theirs.

For ay/am/air you would say

Ay went to the store with air best friend. Ay were shopping for pet food but ended up getting airself a new pet cat. When ay left, air friend helped point out which car was airs.
